texts.zh: 我们在[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交官僚机构中已经筛选出了一批有丑闻潜质的子个体。其中几个的潜在丑闻已经被我方发现，我们的特工正在竭尽全力，确保事情能朝我们希冀的方向发展。
texts.en: We have drawn up a list of potentially scandal-prone figures within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic bureaucracy. Several potential leads have been found, and our operatives are working hard to find the best means by which to manufacture the desired outcome.

texts.zh: 已经为[This.GetName]行动甄别出了一名合适的目标，已经为其取出了详细的宗卷档案。我们的特工静候命令，随时准备散布丑闻。
texts.en: A suitable target for Operation [This.GetName] has been identified, and an extensive dossier has been drawn up. Our operatives wait on our word to trigger the scandal.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工带回了坏消息：他们目前尚无法为[This.GetName]行动甄选出一名合适的目标。显然[Root.Target.GetGovernmentName]对于丑闻的耐受性特别强，我们挖掘到的任何污点都没法在公众间掀起波澜。
texts.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] bring ill tidings: they were not able to find a suitable target for Operation [This.GetName]. Apparently the [Root.Target.GetGovernmentName] is sufficiently scandal-torn that any dirt we discovered on them would hardly have raised a stir.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：经过一次大胆的行动，我们设法陷害了对方一名驻[offended_party.GetName]的特使，使其罪名缠身。这一事件让他们感到非常尴尬，并导致他们同[offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的关系变得十分紧张。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
texts.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: in a bold move, we were able to frame one of their envoys to the [offended_party.GetName] for a surprisingly wide range of crimes. The affair has caused them considerable embarrassment and strained their relations with the [offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：经过一次大胆的行动，我们设法让对方驻扎在我们帝国的一名特使深陷一系列范围极其广泛的罪行中。这件事使他们相当尴尬，我们假意的冒犯在很大程度上加剧了他们的尴尬。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
texts.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: in a bold feint, we were able to frame one of their envoys to our own empire for a surprisingly wide range of crimes. The affair has caused them considerable embarrassment, exaggerated in no small part by the offense we have pretended to take. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：通过把某位特使压下去的失足行为公之于众，我们成功地让他们陷入了空前的尴尬。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
texts.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: by bringing to light some mortifying missteps by one of their envoys, we have managed to cause the them considerable embarrassment. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：经过一些巧妙的运作，我们成功抹黑了[Root.Target.GetAdj]同[offended_party.GetName]的关系。他们的一名特使踏入了我们精心设下的圈套，不经意间吐露了他们对同行的真实看法，令外界所不耻。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
texts.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: through some clever manipulation, we have managed to tarnish [Root.Target.GetAdj] relations with the [offended_party.GetName]. One of their envoys took the bait we carefully set up for them, and accidentally publicly revealed their true thoughts - which proved to be deliciously unsavory - about their counterparts. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：经过一些巧妙的运作，我们成功地抹黑了[Root.Target.GetAdj]同我们自己国家的关系。他们的一名特使踏入了我们精心设下的圈套，不经意间把自己对我国外交官的看法——外界看来这是非常不明智的——吐露了出来。结果，[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交立场被削弱了。
texts.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: through some clever manipulation, we have managed to tarnish [Root.Target.GetAdj] relations with our own empire. One of their envoys took the bait we carefully set up for them, and was tricked into publicly revealing some deliciously unsavory, private thoughts about our own diplomats. [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：我们成功曝光了一场游说丑闻。我们匿名举报，揭发他们在星海共同体工作的一位特使，是如何受贿为[Root.Target.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]讲话的，而该组织与[Root.Target.GetAdj]的利益截然相反。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
texts.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: we were able to spark a lobbying scandal. All that was needed was an anonymous tip-off detailing exactly how much one of their envoys to the Galactic Community was being paid to represent the [Root.Target.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists] - an organization diametrically opposed to [Root.Target.GetAdj] interests. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

texts.zh:
我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：看来他们的一名特使和异星人坠入了爱河——这对该物种来说是严重的罪行。经过循循诱导，我们帮助其避开了[Root.Target.GetAdj]的安保队，并成功地劝说他们和伴侣私奔到一个更加开放包容的社会。

这一事件造成了一系列公开的令人不适的质疑，并将[Root.Target.GetGovernmentName]置于艰难的外交境地。
texts.en:
Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: it turned out that one of their envoys had fallen in love with a xeno - a grave offense among their kind. With some gentle persuasion - and our help with evading [Root.Target.GetAdj] security forces - we were able to persuade them to elope with their partner and seek refuge in a more tolerant society.

This incident has brought uncomfortable questions to the fore and put the [Root.Target.GetGovernmentName] in a difficult diplomatic situation.

texts.zh:
我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：以一些温和的劝说和对录音装置的巧妙利用，我们成功地曝光了他们的一名特使与[Root.Target.GetAdj]所指定的标准有多巨大的偏差。

这一事件造成了一系列公开的令人不适的质疑，并且让[Root.Target.GetAdj]的外交立场变得十分艰难。
texts.en:
Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: with some gentle persuasion - and clever use of recording equipment - we were able to expose just how far one of their envoys had drifted from [Root.Target.GetAdj] norms on their assignment.

This incident has brought uncomfortable questions to the fore and put the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps in a difficult situation.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.Target.GetName]的特工报告，[This.GetName]行动获得了广泛的成功：他们一位特使的药物滥用行为被公之于众，使得一些声名狼藉的毒枭对他们的决策能力施加了不当影响。结果，该国的外交立场被削弱了。
texts.en: Our agents in the [Root.Target.GetName] report that Operation [This.GetName] was a resounding success: the matter was resolved by bringing to light one of their envoys' substance abuse, which had allowed malevolent drug lords undue influence over their decisions. Their diplomatic standing is weakened as a result.

tooltips.zh: [Root.Target.GetName]外交使团的可信度变得支离破碎了。
tooltips.en: The credibility of the [Root.Target.GetName]'s diplomatic corps lies in tatters.

Incredible as it may seem, it appears that there simply aren't any bad apples within the [Root.Target.GetAdj] diplomatic corps at the moment.

summary.text:
# 搜寻目标 / Seeking Targets

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt:89-152`; `events/nemesis_operations_events_2.txt`
- DLC：Nemesis
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

行动 operation_diplomatic_incident（引爆外交事故）：需要 Nemesis DLC、执行者通讯>3；成本影响力30，维持能量5，间谍力25，三个难度 T1 的阶段；目标是默认国家且不嗜杀、非集群，通讯>3，近期没有同类事件（operation_diplomatic_incident_timer）。

The operation operation_diplomatic_incident ("Stage a Diplomatic Incident"): needs Nemesis and the performer with more than 3 communications; cost 30 influence, upkeep 5 energy, spy power 25, three tier-1 stages; the target is a non-homicidal, non-gestalt default country with more than 3 communications and no recent incident (operation_diplomatic_incident_timer).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

8200“寻找目标”→ 8205“挖掘丑闻”→ 8210“更新：行动”（选“开始行动”，或“可惜”放弃）→ 15天后隐藏 8220 判定：成功则 8230“我们制造的丑闻”（陷害对方一位特使），失败则 8225“滴水不漏”（对方没有上钩，行动取消）。

8200 "Seeking Targets" -> 8205 "Digging for Dirt" -> 8210 "Update: Operation" (choose "Commence Operation!" or give up with "Unfortunate") -> 15 days later hidden 8220 decides: success gives 8230 "A Scandal of our Making" (one of their envoys is framed), failure gives 8225 "Squeaky Clean" (the bait is not taken; the operation is cancelled).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

8230 与 8225 互斥；也可在 8210 放弃。

8230 and 8225 are exclusive; one can also give up at 8210.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了行动与 8200–8230（成功标志 operation_succeeded）。

The operation and 8200-8230 (success flag operation_succeeded) were checked.
